description:
Incorporated in 1984, North Eastern Carrying Corporation Ltd is in the business of Transportation [1]

Key Points:
Business Overview: [1] [2] The Company provides logistics and transportation services through Commercial Vehicles and Electric Commercial Vehicles (EVs), offering customised PTL, FTL, ODC and Bulk transportation solutions across India, with a strong presence in the Northern and North-Eastern regions. It also operates in Nepal, Bhutan, Tibet and border areas of Bangladesh, providing integrated services including warehousing and customs clearance.
